prompt: Build a left-aligned triangle of asterisks as a single string using nested loops. Complete the starTriangle method in the starter file, then run the tests.
explanation: Nested loops are the natural shape here: the outer loop runs once per row, and the inner loop appends as many stars as the row number. The tricky part is the separator -- appending "\n" only when another row follows (row < n) avoids a trailing newline. A StringBuilder is preferred over repeated String concatenation inside loops.
hints: Use an outer loop for rows 1..n and an inner loop that appends row-number stars.
Append to a StringBuilder and return sb.toString() at the end.
To avoid a trailing newline, only append '\n' when the current row is not the last one (row < n).
